data.author: Department of Finance Canada
data.summary: Arenas, ice rinks, and recreational facilities are at the heart of many communities across Canada. They are where so many Canadians first learn to skate, where young Canadians gather after school and adults lace up after work, and where families and friends huddle in the stands for the sports they love. But many of these facilities are aging and need significant investment to remain safe, accessible, and ready to serve their communities for years to come.
